Mistfall Hunter Beginner Guide - Everything You Should Know Before You Play
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be giving you guys some tips for Mistfall Hunter, which is the latest extraction dark fantasy action RPG that has just come out a few days ago that aims to stand on its own through unqiue combination of extraction and medieval action. RPG combat in Mistfall Hunter can be difficult to find your bearings if you're new to the extration genre, and this video is going to provide you with some tips and tricks that can get you on your feet quickly.
